subject: executor: skip TopN collection for single-column unique indexes (#66236)
summary: Reviewed `git diff d99e7bb^1..d99e7bb` focusing on executor/statistics changes. The commit disables TopN collection by setting `numTopN=0` when analyzing a public single-column unique/primary index (non-prefix, non-partial) for both column and index tasks (`pkg/executor/analyze_col.go`, `pkg/executor/analyze_col_v2.go`) and wires `tableInfo` into `AnalyzeColumnsExec` (`pkg/executor/builder.go`). Confirmed `pkg/statistics/builder.go:BuildHistAndTopN` handles `numTopN==0` safely (TopN empty; histogram still built). Quick later-history scan up to `upstream/master` for the touched executor files didn’t show a follow-up rollback/fix indicative of a Blocker/High issue.
